tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send a single SMS message to a phone number in E.164 format (+212600000000).

tools.name: send_bulk_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS message to multiple recipients in E.164 format at once (up to 100 recipients).

tools.name: send_whatsapp_template
tools.description: Send an approved WhatsApp template message from the account's connected WhatsApp Business number. Templates may open a conversation at any time (no 24-hour window). Billed like the same send on POST /v1/messages.

tools.name: get_message_status
tools.description: Check the real-time delivery status, segments, and cost of a sent message by ID.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List recent outbound messages for the authenticated account with optional filters.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Check remaining SMS credit balance in MAD and account status.

tools.name: create_topup
tools.description: Create a balance top-up checkout link (Stripe card or crypto USDC) for the authenticated account.

tools.name: send_otp
tools.description: Send a 6-digit OTP verification code via SMS or WhatsApp.

tools.name: verify_otp
tools.description: Verify an OTP passcode against a previously sent code.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List SMS marketing campaigns created on the account.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List saved contacts or search contacts by name, phone, or email.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get SMS & WhatsApp message delivery metrics, success rates, and volume statistics.

tools.name: ops_pulse
tools.description: Admin only. Business health snapshot: margin, cash collected, customer float (liability), solvency ratio, active accounts, and money stuck in the refund-review queue.

tools.name: ops_route_quality
tools.description: Admin only. Delivery quality per carrier/provider/channel, failure codes, DLR plausibility (whether delivery reports can be trusted), and ported-number routing hints. The data behind any provider-routing decision.

tools.name: ops_monitoring
tools.description: Admin only. Current operational state: open ops alerts by severity, upstream gateway balance, and known issues that need attention right now.

tools.name: lookup_number
tools.description: Inspect a phone number: validate format, identify Moroccan operator (IAM / Maroc Telecom, Orange, Inwi) or international country, and view applicable rate. Public — no authentication required.

tools.name: list_sender_ids
tools.description: Consultation des noms d'expéditeurs alphanumériques validés par l'ANRT. List approved and pending custom alphanumeric Sender IDs registered on the authenticated account.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get EnvoiSMS pricing. Pass `to` (a phone number in E.164, e.g. +2348012345678) for that destination's per-SMS rate; omit it for Moroccan rates and credit packs. Public — no authentication required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_whatsapp_template, get_message_status, list_messages, list_contacts, get_analytics, ops_monitoring · Private data: list_contacts · Public sink: send_sms, send_bulk_sms, send_whatsapp_template, get_balance, send_otp, list_campaigns, list_contacts, get_analytics, get_pricing · Destructive: send_sms, send_bulk_sms, lookup_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_whatsapp_template, get_message_status, list_messages, list_contacts, get_analytics, ops_monitoring · Private data: list_contacts · Public sink: send_sms, send_bulk_sms, send_whatsapp_template, get_balance, send_otp, list_campaigns, list_contacts, get_analytics, get_pricing · Destructive: send_sms, send_bulk_sms, lookup_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "send_sms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Send an SMS message to a phone number in E.164 format." → after: "Send a single SMS message to a phone number in E.164 format (+212600000000)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
